sc_cat_item_producer.description:
Use this form to request equipment from the University IT Equipment Pool.

You can request the following equipment:

  • Laptops
  • Projectors
  • Cameras
  • Other approved IT equipment

Please provide the required details, including the equipment needed, borrowing period, and purpose of use.

Approval from the Department Head may be required before the request is fulfilled by the IT Equipment Team.

Once approved, the IT team will verify equipment availability and arrange checkout.

Request Process:
  1. Submit Equipment Request
  2. Department Head Approval
  3. IT Team Review and Fulfillment
  4. Equipment Checkout
  5. Equipment Return

Equipment must be returned on or before the due date.
